meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: Claude 会组建 5 人安全研究团队(3 名漏洞猎人、2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,用概念验证(PoC)验证或排除可疑漏洞,按 CWE 分类根因,依据可利用性定严重程度,并输出含结论、修复建议与残余风险的报告。
howto.when: 当用户提到“security-research”等触发词,或要求做漏洞审计、发布前检查、威胁建模时触发;需团队模式开启并在主会话,有仓库、diff 等明确目标,否则默认审计当前仓库与分支改动。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库。
say.note: 启动 5 人团队审计并产出报告。

say.text: 对最新提交的 diff 做 security review。
say.note: 把该 diff 作为审计范围。

say.text: /security-research 检查这个 PR 能否发布。
say.note: 返回 PASS、BLOCK 或带发现通过。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a parallel audit (3 hunters, 2 PoC engineers) that proves/falsifies exploits, classifies CWE root causes, rates severity by exploitability, and outputs a report.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security-research', 'security review', or 'vulnerability audit' requests. Requires team mode, main session, and a target (repo, diff, etc.). Without a target, it audits the current repo and branch diff.

say_en.text: Run security-research on the current repo.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-person audit and produces a report.

say_en.text: Run security review on the latest diff.
say_en.note: Uses that diff as the audit scope.

say_en.text: Use /security-research to vet this PR for release.
say_en.note: Returns PASS, BLOCK, or PASS WITH FINDINGS.
